Unmodified corresponding source for the Symphonia crates used in Mytify 0.4.
MPL-2.0; copyright notices retained in each source file.
Cargo.lock pins their original registry checksums.
These sources are provided for availability and inspection; the main build uses pinned Cargo registry versions.

symphonia 0.5.5
  source: symphonia-0.5.5/
  upstream: https://static.crates.io/crates/symphonia/symphonia-0.5.5.crate
